adversarial_cases.expected: Flow, amortisation and maturities are settled known 0 (T2E.3.r05-r07): three plotted zero-height steps with text 0, never gaps and never omitted.

Maturities (50) and cash at horizon end (30) are signed settled amounts (T2E.3.r07 amount -50, r08 amount -30). The closing total plots below zero; marks carry the bracket spelling of the settled cell.

Minimum cash is missing (headroom, gap and runway months are gaps in T2E.3/T2E.5) but every bridge fact T2E.2.r01 and T2E.3.r05-r08 is known and identical to positive; the bridge is drawn in full with no gap mark.
Undrawn revolver and available liquidity are missing, cash at horizon end before refinancing is known (derived-only fixture); the revolver is not a bridge step.
Flow over the horizon -12 and closing 8 with opening 20 (derived-only fixture): the flow step is a negative delta; the identity holds.

Rule-derived, no settled case: when a bridge fact is missing (missing_rule, CP2D-OWNER-LEASE.md:50) its mark is a gap with its G# reference, never 0, and the closing total (which depends on it) is also a gap. A composer fixture or a forged module view must exercise it.
Q-C3: exactly five points; no lease, mandatory-use or capex step; the figure note states the difference from the design.
A mark's value is the settled table amount (outflows negative), not the magnitude in `derived` (maturities_in_horizon 50).
